reason_for_p24_disk_guard: Protocol-023's 20 GiB guard was registered for a local workstation. The GitHub-hosted runner exposed 10.897 GiB free before interval 0, so the inherited 20 GiB threshold can never run here. Protocol-024 artifacts are bounded arrays for 4981x16 hosts plus model outputs and are far below 5 GiB; 5 GiB therefore preserves a substantial safety margin without changing experiment physics.
